translations.web: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.
translations.bsb: tremble before Him, all the earth. The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
translations.kjv: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.
translations.asv: Tremble before him, all the earth: The world also is established that it cannot be moved.
